title: What nobody tells you about working at Google in 2026

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What hidden challenges will Google employees face in 2026 that aren't in the job descriptions?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Quantum computing and AI alignment are pushing boundaries, but tools like Qiskit and TensorFlow are still in early stages.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Employees may face pressure to prioritize profit over privacy, as AI-driven surveillance becomes more integrated into internal systems.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Teams are experimenting with federated learning to protect data while still training robust models across departments.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI ethics are baked into workflows, with real-time bias detection tools used in every project.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future at Google will be shaped by those who balance innovation with responsibility.

video_cue: A montage of Google engineers and ethicists collaborating in a futuristic office with holographic displays and AI dashboards.
